properties.displayName: Asset Entity ASIM parser for Microsoft Sentinel native Asset Entity table
properties.query:
let parser = (disabled:bool=false, pack:bool=false) {
  ASimAssetEntityLogs
  | where not(disabled)
  | extend
      EntitySchema = "AssetEntity",
      EntityUpdatedTime = coalesce(EntityUpdatedTime, TimeGenerated),
      EntityIngestionTime = coalesce(EntityIngestionTime, TimeGenerated),
      AssetPath = coalesce(FilePath, SitePath),
      User = AssetOwnerId,
      AdditionalFields = iff(pack, AdditionalFields, dynamic({}))
  | project
      TimeGenerated, Type, EntitySchema, EntitySchemaVersion, EntityUpdatedTime,
      EntityIngestionTime, EntityKey, EntityId, EntityIdType, EntityOriginalId,
      EntityName, EntityNameType, AssetType, AssetOriginalType,
      EntityVendor, EntitySource, EntityOriginalSource, EntityProduct, EntitySubProduct,
      EntityCreatedTime, EntityLastAccessedTime, EntityLastModifiedTime,
      EntityIsDeleted, EntityFeedType, EntitySnapshotId,
      AssetOwnerId, AssetOwnerIdType, AssetOwnerType, AssetOwnerScope, AssetOwnerScopeId,
      AdditionalAssetOwners, AssetOriginalPermissions, AssetOriginalRiskDetails,
      AssetRiskName, AssetRiskLevel, AssetOriginalRiskLevel,
      AssetRiskFirstReportedTime, AssetRiskLastReportedTime,
      AssetSensitivityLabel, AssetOriginalSensitivityLevel, AssetIsProtectedByDlp,
      AssetRelatedIndicators, AssetOriginalDataClassificationType,
      AssetClassificationLastScanDateTime, AADTenantId,
      IdentityDirectoryName, IdentityDirectoryId, InternalUsersCount, ExternalUsersCount,
      FilePath, FileSize, FileMD5, FileSHA1, FileSHA256, FileSHA512, FileExtension,
      FileIsSignatureValid, FileSignatureDetails, SitePath, SitePrimaryUri,
      AssetPath, User, AdditionalFields
};
parser(disabled=disabled, pack=pack)
